text:
sara: kicking off prod-us rollout for search-service v4.0.0 during change window. staged: 5% for 8m -> 25% for 12m. gating: p99 latency, 5xx rate, and error budget burn. ill start the 5% canary now.

deploy-bot: rollout started by sara. environment=prod-us, version=v4.0.0. steps=[5%:8m,25%:12m]. auto-rollback threshold: p99 > 800ms or 5xx > 0.5% sustained 3m.

monitoring-bot: initial gate snapshot: p99 baseline=420ms, current p99(3m)=430ms. 5xx baseline=0.08%, current=0.09%. no alert yet. sending chart.

tom: noticed small tail on p99 for /search/query around the canary. not huge but repeated spikes to ~650ms. checking traces.

ops-bot: alert: ephemeral 502 burst detected at 2026-03-21T18:15:02Z on k8s-pod search-7b9f; rate spike 0.3% over 1m window. not persistent.

leo: per-traces the slow requests correlate with node-s13 cpu steal and lock contention during model load. might be warmup related.

sara: hold progression. keep at 5%. monitoring-bot, can you run a pre/post delta for top endpoints and show node-level breakdown?

monitoring-bot: delta report (5m pre vs 5m post): /search/query p99 +180ms, /suggest p99 +60ms. top problematic nodes: node-s13, node-s04. Docker restarts observed on node-s13 within canary window. suggestion: route canary to nodes with image tag warmup-enabled or increase init delay.

tom: patch idea: enable small prefetch warmup on canary pods and re-route the 5% to warmed nodes. otherwise we should pin to v3.9.8.

sara: decision: do not advance. attempt warmup on a separate 2-node pool and divert the 5% there. if we see >0.4% 5xx or p99>700ms sustained 2m, we will pin to v3.9.8 and open OPS ticket.

deploy-bot: diversion enacted: 5% traffic now routed to warmed-pool. change window annotated: "diverted to warmed pool - monitoring".

monitoring-bot: 4m post-diversion: p99 improving to 460ms, 5xx stable at 0.11%. one pod restart on node-s13 still timing out during model init.

leo: continuing to tail logs. im seeing the model loader retry thrash on node-s13 causing short tcp backoffs. filing INFRA-2110.

ops-bot: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2110 (node-s13 model init failures).

tom: if warmed pool holds at ~480ms p99 and errors <0.2% over next 10m we can proceed to 25% with canary-only warmup. sara, do you want to hold for 10m or pin now?

sara: hold 10m. update release notes: "paused advance due to model init thrash on subset of nodes; diverted canary to warmed pool; will proceed after 10m of stability or pin to v3.9.8 if breach." tagging @oncall.

deploy-bot: change window note appended. auto-rollback still armed.

monitoring-bot: final check at +10m: warmed pool p99=490ms, overall p99=470ms, 5xx=0.12%. no hard SLO breach. recommendation: proceed to 25% with warmed pool only and continue monitoring 15m.

sara: proceeding to 25% with warmed-only routing. update: release notes updated and post-mortem ticket queued if regression persists. thanks all. :rocket:
